question: Are the strongest static-feedback effects returned at a54f478 (paired fixed-area CL and rigidized-descent range differences among rigid, one-way frozen-load and two-way feedback arms) resolved with respect to the VLM lattice, and, given that, which conditional contexts justify higher-fidelity analysis?
evidence_kind: computed numerical-resolution diagnostic of an assumed equivalent-fin bending scaffold; not fish performance, not empirical validation

physics_unchanged.statement: Every arm runs engineering.aeroelastic.run.solve_arm unchanged with the original protocol.json (EI, alpha, rho, speeds, mass, CD0, e, height, dt, gates, underrelaxation, iteration budget). Only the VLM lattice varies, through solve_arm's existing grid_override argument. No twist model, no new stiffness, no inferred genomic or tissue values; EI remains the assumed design scaffold.

selected_contexts.why: largest returned effects (one-way minus rigid dCL -0.00587 main / -0.00590 fine; feedback increment +9.0e-5) and nearest the declared 0.1 tip/span domain limit (one-way pectoral 0.0985 main / 0.0990 fine)
largest effects well inside the domain (one-way minus rigid dCL -0.00360; feedback +3.1e-5; tip/span 0.063)
nominal reference context shared with the control slice and the joint-uncertainty nominal row (dCL -0.00134; feedback +3.8e-6)

excluded_contexts: chi0.05 (both speeds) and chi0.2-u16: smaller effects of the same sign; not consequential for the decision below. Their returned results stand unchanged.

main.path: original production mesh label (grid_override=None); same-job reproduction of a54f478

fine.path: original production mesh label (grid_override=None); same-job reproduction of a54f478

refinement_scope: Span and chord panel counts per fin are refined together at fixed 4:1; spanwise cosine spacing and chordwise uniform spacing are the existing vlm.lattice rules. Span and chord errors are not separated. The upstream source lattice (48x16) is not on this ladder.

T1.5.role: independent second estimate sharing only the coarsest level

reference_scope: Returned a54f478 production result.json files for the 18 selected main/fine arms, packed byte-for-byte; the packet recomputes these arms and compares, it never replaces them.

effects.CL_rigid: rigid CL (absolute reference quantity, reported, not a decision input)

diagnostic.per_triple: e21 = E_medium - E_coarse, e32 = E_fine - E_medium, R = e32/e21. monotone if 0<R<1; oscillatory if -1<R<0; divergent if |R|>=1; roundoff_insensitive if |e21| and |e32| <= 1e-10 abs + 1e-9 rel. Monotone only: p = ln(1/R)/ln(r), E_ext = E_fine + e32/(r^p - 1), GCI_abs = 1.25|e32|/(r^p - 1), GCI_rel = GCI_abs/|E_fine| (Roache three-grid, Fs 1.25).
diagnostic.numerical_floors: fixed-point: for a two-way arm, rho = max of the last three shape-residual ratios; if rho<1, CL error bound = |CL_change_last| rho/(1-rho), else infinite; one-way and rigid are 0. dt: |range_main - range_half| per arm. A paired effect's floor is the sum over its two arms, at the finest lattice. For range effects the floor adds, per arm, |range_main| x (CL fixed-point bound / CL). For tip/span the floor is the shape residual rho/(1-rho).
diagnostic.resolved: all of: both triples monotone; p in [0.5, 4] in both; GCI_rel(T2) <= 0.10; |E_ext(T2) - E_ext(T1.5)| <= GCI_abs(T2) + GCI_abs(T1.5); same sign on all five lattices; |E_l64x16| >= 10 x its numerical floor
diagnostic.sign_resolved: not resolved, but same sign on all five lattices, |E_l64x16| >= 10 x floor and |E_l64x16| >= 3 x |E_l64x16 - E_l32x8|
diagnostic.not_resolved: anything else, with the failing condition named
diagnostic.not_assessable: any of the 15 arms of a context invalid, failed, partial, not started or a domain exit at any lattice; its status is reported, nothing is substituted; the five-lattice values that do exist are still tabulated descriptively

decision.scope: Decides only whether a context of this bending-only, torsion-rigid, fixed-alpha scaffold is retained as a CONDITIONAL candidate for higher-fidelity analysis (for example torsion-compliant structure or unsteady coupling). It does not claim real fish performance, a trimmed-flight result or tissue properties.
decision.retain_bending: dCL_one_way_minus_rigid resolved AND |E_ext(T2)| / |CL_rigid reference| >= 0.01, where the reference is CL_rigid_ext(T2) when that triple is monotone or roundoff-insensitive, else the l64x16 rigid CL (1% decision precision does not need more)
decision.reject_bending: dCL_one_way_minus_rigid resolved AND that relative magnitude < 0.01
decision.one_way_sufficient: dCL_two_way_minus_one_way resolved or sign_resolved AND (|E_ext| if resolved, else |E_l64x16| + |E_l64x16 - E_l32x8|) < 0.10 x |dCL_one_way_minus_rigid ext|
decision.undetermined: any other outcome; the context is NOT promoted, and the remedy is a finer or separated (span/chord) ladder, never a looser rule
decision.threshold_basis: 1% CL is a declared consequence convention: in the returned descent proxy d ln(range)/d ln(CL) is about 1 at 20 m/s, so 1% CL is about 0.3 m of range, far above the dt (<1e-6 relative) and fixed-point floors. The 10% feedback ratio is likewise a convention. Neither is physics.

expectations_from_two_returned_meshes: Recorded before results, NOT criteria: retain_bending at chi0.8-u20 (-2.34%) and chi0.8-u16 (-1.44%), reject_bending at chi0.2-u20 (-0.53%); one_way_sufficient in all three (feedback increments 1.5%, 0.9%, 0.28% of the one-way effect). chi0.8-u20 may become not_assessable if tip/span crosses 0.1 on finer lattices (0.0985 main to 0.0990 fine).

controls.original: engineering.aeroelastic.controls.run unchanged (20 checks incl. upstream VLM V1-V6); must pass before any arm
controls.same_job_reproduction: main and fine arms recomputed and compared with the packed references: status, iteration count, every iteration CL, final tip/span, flight main/half range; exact equality and fixed-roundoff (abs 1e-10, rel 1e-9) reported separately
controls.per_lattice: on each of the five lattices at 20 m/s rigid load: zero-load panel positions (A, B, C) bitwise exact, zero-load normals within 1e-12 (deform renormalises them), and CL difference <= 1e-12; stiff limit (EI x 1e6, compliance 0.8 EI) CL difference <= 1e-6 and tip/span <= 1e-6; original ledger identities (bookkeeping only)

independent_transfer.stations: panel span stations recomputed from the lattice strip spacing (0.5(ue_i+ue_i+1) - lower) equal Response.stations to 1e-12 m
independent_transfer.axis: n_up recomputed from panels.json fin_plane (e_w x e_u, +z) equals the setup axis to 1e-12 and is orthogonal to e_u to 1e-12; every lattice normal has positive n_up component
independent_transfer.beam_equilibrium: root moment and shear recovered from the superposed beam displacement at two points inboard of every load (EI w = M0 x^2/2 - V0 x^3/6) equal sum(s_ind (F.n_ref)) and sum(F.n_ref) to 1e-8 relative
independent_transfer.upstream_force: rigid fin normal force within 3% of the upstream 48x16 vlm.json reference normal force (cross-artifact scale check)
independent_transfer.mutations: each must make its own check fail: Response rebuilt with stations scaled by 0.8 (stations, beam_equilibrium); setup axis swapped to e_w (axis, beam_equilibrium); unit rho=1,V=1 forces (upstream_force); doubled forces (thin_airfoil_bound, upstream_force); the original zeroed-entry ledger mutation
independent_transfer.upstream_force_basis: returned a54f478 rigid arms sit 1.0-1.7% from the reference on main and fine (read before freezing)

controls.fixed_point_and_dt: a-posteriori fixed-point bound from each two-way iteration history; existing main/half dt range comparison in every arm

failure_policy: All failed, unconverged, partial, not-started and domain-exit arms are saved with their native status. No case, threshold or lattice is added, removed or changed after results. Returned a54f478 passes and failures are never replaced.
measured_runtime_control: filled in packet.json from the local elliptic-wing timing; not a fish result
exit_code: nonzero when a task crashed, a lattice control failed or is missing, an arm is missing, partial or not started, the output cap is exceeded, or setup fails; every result is kept either way

amendments.what: zero-load control split into bitwise panel positions and normals within 1e-12
amendments.why: the local packet preflight (main lattice only, a reproduction of returned arms) failed the first form: deform renormalises N, so a zero load changes normals at roundoff; the original controls.py compares A, B, C only. No arm, lattice, effect, diagnostic or decision rule changed.
